blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Zavier Lucero and Magnolia are embracing the underdog status in their 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series with TNT, which has had the Hotshots’ number in recent playoff battles. “We’re the underdogs coming into the series,” Lucero said, quoting coach LA Tenorio, after Magnolia secured the top spot in Group B with a 107-103 win over Rain or Shine on Wednesday at Ynares Center in Antipolo. The Hotshots topped the group with a 7-3 record behind a six-game winning streak, but will have to go through the Tropang 5G, ranked fourth in Group A, to begin the best-of-five quarters.
